author: Joachim Bornemann

scale.basis: approximate species size; source proportions preserved

limitations: Original PoseLib clip is static. Eye meshes attached to head skin; Rig_Check clips added. Color textures capped at 512px; normal/occlusion maps at 256px (half for LOD1).
visual_review: Accepted after comparison with current fox, rabbit, wolf, chicken, crow, hawk, crocodile, pike and ant under identical headless lighting. Natural proportions; no cartoon/figurine styling. Reimported LOD0/LOD1 and sampled exported poses reviewed.
